# Generate study Dataset

## Set up
```{r}
library(lme4)
library(broom.mixed)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(arrow)
library(cli)
library(stringr)
library(gt)

source("~/data/dwhitake/tonsillectomy_analgesia/scripts/settings.R")
sapply(functions_paths, source, verbose=FALSE)

data_set_details <- load_dataset(data_set = data_set,
                                 root_path = root_path,
                                 output_folder_path = dataset_path)

```


## Select cases from full dataset
```{r cohort generation}
make_cohort <- function(){
rest_of_chapter <- c(paste0("F0", 0:9), paste0("F", 10:33),  paste0("F", 36:99))

q1 <- cohort_encounter_selection(cohort_name = "Tonsillectomy",
                          include_OPCS =  c("F34", "F35"),
                          exclude_OPCS = c("E20",rest_of_chapter),
                          min_age = NA,
                          max_age = NA,
                          case_priority = "elective",
                          return_index_procedures_only=TRUE,
                          verbose = TRUE
                          )

q2 <- cohort_encounter_selection(cohort_name = "Adenoidectomy",
                          include_OPCS =  c("E20"),
                          exclude_OPCS = c("F34", "F35",rest_of_chapter),
                          min_age = NA,
                          max_age = NA,
                          case_priority = "elective",
                          return_index_procedures_only=TRUE,
                          verbose = TRUE
                          )

q3 <- cohort_encounter_selection(cohort_name = "Adenotonsillectomy",
                          include_OPCS =  c("F34", "F35", "E20"),
                          exclude_OPCS = c(rest_of_chapter),
                          min_age = NA,
                          max_age = NA,
                          case_priority = "elective",
                          return_index_procedures_only=TRUE,
                          verbose = TRUE
                          )

q3 <- q3 %>% filter(!EncounterKey %in% q1$EncounterKey) %>% filter(!EncounterKey %in% q2$EncounterKey)


coblation <- cohort_encounter_selection(cohort_name = "Coblation",
                          include_OPCS =  c("Y10.1", "F34.7", "F35.2"),
                          min_age = NA,
                          max_age = NA,
                         case_priority = "elective",
                         return_index_procedures_only=TRUE,
                          verbose = TRUE
                          )

electrocautery <- cohort_encounter_selection(cohort_name = "Electrocautery",
                          include_OPCS =  c("Y10.2", "Y11.1"),
                          exclude_OPCS = c("Y10.1"),
                          min_age = NA,
                          max_age = NA,
                         case_priority = "elective",
                         return_index_procedures_only=TRUE,
                          verbose = TRUE
                          )


full_cohort <- rbind(q1,q2,q3) %>% ungroup()

full_cohort <- full_cohort %>%
  mutate(coblation = ifelse(SurgicalCaseKey %in% coblation$SurgicalCaseKey,TRUE,FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(electrocautery = ifelse(SurgicalCaseKey %in% electrocautery$SurgicalCaseKey,TRUE,FALSE)) 

return(full_cohort)
}

full_cohort <- make_cohort()

```

## Data extraction

For the selected encounters a range of patient factors, surgical factors and anaesthetic factors where extracted.

### Patient factors

```{r extract - patient factors}
#| message: false
#| echo: true

df <- full_cohort %>% left_join(anthropometric %>% collect() %>% dplyr::select(-any_of(c("PatientDurableKey" ,"patient_id" , "INDEX"))) , join_by("EncounterKey"))


#Convert Height in cm
df <- df %>% mutate(Height = Height*100)

df <- df %>% mutate(cohort = factor(cohort, levels=c("Tonsillectomy","Adenoidectomy","Adenotonsillectomy")))

df <- df %>% mutate(adult = factor(ifelse(age>=18,1,0)))

patient_id_list <- df %>% ungroup() %>% select(patient_id) %>% unique() %>% pull()


df <- df %>% left_join(
  get_diagnosis_status(patient_id_list, 
                       icd_to_include = c("R52"), 
                       icd_to_exclude = c("R52.0"),
                       variable_name = "hx_chronic_pain", 
                       format = "binary" )
, join_by(patient_id))

df <- df %>% left_join(
  get_diagnosis_status(patient_id_list, 
                       icd_to_include = c("F11"), 
                       variable_name = "hx_opioid_dependance", 
                       format = "binary" )
, join_by(patient_id))

df <- df %>% left_join(
  get_diagnosis_status(patient_id_list, 
                       icd_to_include = c("J35"), 
                       icd_to_exclude = c("J35.8"),
                       variable_name = "hx_chronic_tonsillitis", 
                       format = "binary" )
, join_by(patient_id))

df <- df %>% left_join(
  get_diagnosis_status(patient_id_list, 
                       icd_to_include = c("G47.3"), 
                       variable_name = "hx_sleep_apnoea", 
                       format = "binary" )
, join_by(patient_id))

# The default behavior of `get_diagnosis_status` is to return a 0 if the patients PMH is found but the diagnosis code of intrest is not found, this is to ensure an NA is assinged if there is an issues with the function. 

if(any(df %>% summarise(across(starts_with("hx"), ~ any(is.na(.)))))){cli_abort("There are some patients who's PMH itens are not returning correctly ")}


```

```{r extract - Intra-op opioids}
#| message: false

#Each strong opioid

for (i in 1:length(strong_opioid_list)){
  
  if(strong_opioid_list[i] == "remifentanil"){
  opioid_string <- search_drug_names(anes_medication, "remi")$Name
  search_col <- "Name"
  variable_name <- paste0("intra_op_", "remifentanil", "_dose")
  given_variable_name <-  paste0("intra_op_", "remifentanil", "_given")
  }else{
  opioid_string <- strong_opioid_list[i]
  variable_name <- paste0("intra_op_", str_replace_all(opioid_string, " ", "_"), "_dose")
  given_variable_name <-  paste0("intra_op_", str_replace_all(opioid_string, " ", "_"), "_given")
   search_col <- "SimpleGenericName"
  }
  
  
  doses <- get_all_intraop_drug_given(surgical_case_keys,
  drug_generic_name = opioid_string,
  format = "total_dose",
  variable_name = variable_name,
  search_column = search_col)

  
  doses$given <- ifelse(is.na(doses[,2]),0,1)
  doses <- doses %>% rename(!!given_variable_name := given)

  df <- df %>% left_join(doses)
  
}

df <- df %>% mutate(intra_op_morphine_sulfate_dose_per_kg = intra_op_morphine_sulfate_dose/Weight)
df <- df %>% mutate(intra_op_fentanyl_dose = intra_op_fentanyl_dose*1000)
df <- df %>% mutate(intra_op_fentanyl_dose_per_kg = intra_op_fentanyl_dose/Weight)
```

## Treatment arm

```{r treatment arm labelling}

df$treatment_arm <- NA

df <- df %>%
  mutate(simple_analgesia_given = case_when(
    intra_op_and_pre_paracetamol_given == 1 &
      intra_op_diclofenac_given == 1 &
      intra_op_dexamethasone_given == 1 ~ 1L,
      .default = 0)) %>%
  mutate(
    opioid_given = case_when(
    intra_op_morphine_sulfate_given == 1 |
      intra_op_fentanyl_given == 1 ~ 1L,
      .default = 0))%>%
  mutate(
    treatment_arm = case_when(

      # Exclusion drugs → NA
     # intra_op_clonidine_given == 1 |
    #  intra_op_ketamine_given == 1 |
    #  intra_op_magnesium_given == 1 ~ NA_integer_,

      # Group 1
      intra_op_and_pre_paracetamol_given == 1 &
      intra_op_diclofenac_given == 1 &
      intra_op_dexamethasone_given == 1 &
      intra_op_morphine_sulfate_given == 0 &
      intra_op_fentanyl_given == 0 &
      intra_op_clonidine_given == 0 &
      intra_op_ketamine_given == 0 &
      intra_op_magnesium_given == 0 ~ 1L,

      # Group 2
      intra_op_and_pre_paracetamol_given == 1 &
      intra_op_diclofenac_given == 1 &
      intra_op_dexamethasone_given == 1 &
      intra_op_morphine_sulfate_given == 1 &
      intra_op_fentanyl_given == 0 &
      intra_op_clonidine_given == 0 &
      intra_op_ketamine_given == 0 &
      intra_op_magnesium_given == 0 ~ 2L,

      # Group 3
      intra_op_and_pre_paracetamol_given == 1 &
      intra_op_diclofenac_given == 1 &
      intra_op_dexamethasone_given == 1 &
      intra_op_morphine_sulfate_given == 0 &
      intra_op_fentanyl_given == 1 &
      intra_op_clonidine_given == 0 &
      intra_op_ketamine_given == 0 &
      intra_op_magnesium_given == 0 ~ 3L,

      # Group 4
      intra_op_and_pre_paracetamol_given == 1 &
      intra_op_diclofenac_given == 1 &
      intra_op_dexamethasone_given == 1 &
      intra_op_morphine_sulfate_given == 1 &
      intra_op_fentanyl_given == 1 &
      intra_op_clonidine_given == 0 &
      intra_op_ketamine_given == 0 &
      intra_op_magnesium_given == 0 ~ 4L,

      # Anything else
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )


df$treatment_arm <- as.factor(df$treatment_arm)

```

## Sensitvity Analysis

```{r sensititivty analysis recovery_opioids}
#| message: false

strong_opioid_list <- c("morphine sulfate", "oxycodone hydrochloride", "fentanyl", "diamorphine hydrochloride")

med_drug_names <- medication %>% filter(SimpleGenericName %in% strong_opioid_list) %>% select(GenericName, SimpleGenericName) %>% unique() %>% collect() 

med_order_drug_names <- medication_order %>% filter(SimpleGenericName %in% strong_opioid_list) %>% select(GenericName, SimpleGenericName) %>% unique() %>% collect() 

opioid_generic_names <- c(med_drug_names$GenericName, med_order_drug_names$GenericName) %>% unique()

recovery_meds <-  get_all_drug_given(encounter_keys =  df$EncounterKey,
                   drug_generic_name = opioid_generic_names,
                   search_column = "GenericName",
                  surgery_end_datetime = df$OperationInstant + df$ProcedureLengthMinutes,
                  post_op_length = 24*60,
                  timeframe = "post_op",
                  format = "all_rows",
                  variable_name = "ome_post_op",
                  verbose = FALSE) 

surg_times <- data.frame(EncounterKey =  df$EncounterKey,surgery_end_datetime = df$OperationInstant + df$ProcedureLengthMinutes)

sensititvity_df <- recovery_meds %>% select(EncounterKey, AdministrationInstant) %>% left_join(surg_times) %>% mutate(med_time = as.numeric(difftime(AdministrationInstant,surgery_end_datetime, units = "mins")))

opioid_sensititvity_df <- sensititvity_df %>% group_by(EncounterKey) %>% slice_min(med_time) %>% select(med_time) 

```

```{r sensititivty analysis readmission}
#| message: false

readmissions <-  find_readmission(index_encounter_keys = df$EncounterKey,
                 encounter_types = "ed",
                 format="all_rows",
                 variable_name = "ed_visit_in_30d",
                 cutoff = 40) 

readmissions <- readmissions %>%
  rename(ed_encounterkey = EncounterKey)%>%
  group_by(index_encounter_key) %>%
  slice_min(Date) %>%
  select(index_encounter_key, ed_encounterkey, Date)

discharge_times <- data.frame(PatientDurableKey  =  df$PatientDurableKey,
                              Index_encounter_discharge = df$EndInstant,
                              index_encounter_key = df$EncounterKey) 

readmit_sensititvity_df <- readmissions %>%
  rename(ED_visit_date = Date) %>%
  left_join(discharge_times ) %>%
  mutate(readmit_time = as.numeric(difftime(ED_visit_date,Index_encounter_discharge, units = "days")))  %>%
  filter(readmit_time >=0)%>% group_by(PatientDurableKey) %>% slice_min(readmit_time)  %>% select(readmit_time)


```

# Write dataset

```{r write dataset}

saveRDS(df, file=paste0(root_path, "/data/id_dataset.rds"))

saveRDS(opioid_sensititvity_df, file=paste0(root_path, "/data/id_opioid_sensititvity_df.rds"))

saveRDS(readmit_sensititvity_df, file=paste0(root_path, "/data/id_readmit_sensititvity_df.rds"))

```
